title: Personality and Character Traits
description: Explore key adjectives to describe personalities, behavior, and character with definitions and examples.

thumbnail.alt: A group of diverse smiling people expressing different emotions and attitudes
thumbnail.prompt: A group of diverse smiling people expressing different emotions and friendly attitudes

back.definition: Friendly and socially confident, enjoying the company of others.
back.example: Sara is very outgoing and makes friends wherever she goes.

back.definition: Consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted.
back.example: You can always count on Mark; he is the most reliable person on our team.

back.definition: Having a strong desire and determination to succeed in life.
back.example: The ambitious student launched two tech projects before graduating.

back.definition: Willing to give more money, time, or help than is expected.
back.example: Our neighbors were generous enough to share their fresh produce with us.

back.definition: Determined not to change one's attitude or opinion on something.
back.example: He refused to ask for directions because he was too stubborn to admit he was lost.

back.definition: Awkward in movement or in handling things; prone to accidents.
back.example: I felt clumsy this morning when I dropped my cup and spilled my tea.

back.definition: Able to accept or tolerate delays or problems without becoming annoyed.
back.example: Teaching requires a calm and patient mindset.

back.definition: Eager to know or learn something new.
back.example: The curious child asked questions about how the solar system works.

back.definition: Showing quick and inventive verbal humor.
back.example: Everyone laughed at her witty remarks during the presentation.

back.definition: Showing an ability to understand and share the feelings of another.
back.example: A good counselor is empathetic and listens without judging.
